'''Jerry Flynn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[November 2000 Minneapolis tournament (28 November)]] on 28 November 2000, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1500">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-28-mirkwood-minnesota-2000d1500/ mirkwood-minnesota-2000], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 28 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-28-mirkwood-minnesota-2000d1500/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
